messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
At what interval is it necessary to inspect the load nut's wear indicator on the MA STAR two post lift?

response.text: Con quale intervallo è necessario ispezionare l'indicatore di usura del dado di carico del ponte a due colonne MA STAR?
